nested_functions: heapify (line 115, PAR=7) is inside simulate_heapsort (line 113, PAR=5). By the outermost-function rule, the two detections form a single instance. Removing the smell applies to both.
external_dependencies: none: the snippet does not touch pygame; the helper functions do, and they became pure-Python scaffolding
copied_verbatim: lines 68 to 73: body of compare_elements (the signature changed, see scaffolding)
comments_in_snippet: Kept, by rule 1 (verbatim snippet), the comment '# generated by github copilot' on line 114, which reveals the origin of the code. Same treatment as the docstring of LPL-01: recorded as a limitation.

lines 5 to 8 and 10 to 16, colors, window size, PROP and comments: they only served the real drawing; clock = None (line 10) became the clock of the scaffolding.

draw_element (19), get_element_texts (35), matrix_comparisons (52), compare_and_swap (76), simulate_bubblesort (92), simulate_insertionsort (102), simulate_quicksort (146), simulate_sort_algorithm (185) and the __main__ block (213): outside the snippet and not called by it.
scaffolding: draw_array: same signature as the original (4 parameters counted; the default of poses_elevated became an empty tuple instead of a list); instead of drawing with pygame, it stores a frame on the screen: (texts in the current order, highlighted positions, width, height).

compare_elements: body copied from the original (lines 68 to 73), signature changed from (display, arrTexts, width_reference, height_reference, arr, i, j) to (display, arrTexts, *args), unpacking the rest in the first line. With 7 parameters it would trigger LPL in the scaffolding (PAR=7), and removing the smell would be impossible; the calls in the snippet, with 7 positional arguments, still work.
_Text (already rendered text, only the value), _Screen (list of frames) and _Clock (stores the rate of each tick); clock is a module-level _Clock, like the global of the original.
run(values): sorts a copy, with width 40 and height 100, and returns (sorted list, frames, tick rates).
Checked: Pysmell only flags simulate_heapsort (PAR=5) and heapify (PAR=7); nothing in the scaffolding.
pinned_behavior: typical: [2, 3, 1] becomes [1, 2, 3]; the 11 frames in the exact order (5 comparisons, pairs (0,1), (1,2), (0,1), (0,1), (0,1), each with one frame without highlight and one with highlight, plus the final frame), width and height passed on without swapping, and 11 ticks at rate 3. Step-by-step count in the docstring of the test.
edge: empty list; only the final frame and 1 tick.
invalid: [3, 'a', 1] raises TypeError in the comparison.
not_pinned_on_purpose: Identity of the sorted list: run sorts a copy and returns the result; the test checks the content.
Real drawing (colors, positions in pixels): the scaffolding does not draw, it only records what would be drawn.
